rows.original_verbatim:
@BDD-22 @M07 @REQ-19
  規則: 無變更略過
    場景: 無變更略過
      假如 內容與上次成功快照相同
      當 經過下一個60秒檢查點
      那麼 不新增復原快照
rows.pending_fixture: same captured content at every polling tick 60/120/180; changed at 240
rows.observable_oracle: payload/index count unchanged until changed content; exactly one new successful snapshot after change
rows.new_seams: PENDING_OWNER; no new API/port/schema/transaction approval implied

@BDD-23 @M07 @REQ-19
  規則: 首次未保存內容
    場景: 首次未保存內容
      假如 新文件已有尚未保存的內容且沒有成功快照
      當 到達60秒檢查點
      那麼 該內容及必要素材納入首次快照
rows.pending_fixture: unsaved R1 with immutable material bytes; no successful snapshot; 59/60/61 controlled seconds
rows.observable_oracle: 59 no capture;60 eligible once;61 no duplicate; recovered payload and material hashes equal captured R1
rows.new_seams: PENDING_OWNER; no new API/port/schema/transaction approval implied

rows.original_verbatim:
@BDD-24 @M07 @REQ-20
  規則: 寫入期間再變更
    場景: 寫入期間再變更
      假如 快照版本R正在保存
      當 使用者再編輯成R加1
      那麼 R成功只更新至R基準，R加1留待後續檢查
rows.pending_fixture: hold R write;edit R+1;complete R;next eligible poll
rows.observable_oracle: baseline advances to R only;R+1 remains pending and next snapshot contains R+1
rows.new_seams: PENDING_OWNER; no new API/port/schema/transaction approval implied

rows.original_verbatim:
@BDD-25 @M07 @REQ-20
  規則: 失敗重試
    場景: 失敗重試
      假如 已有有效快照且本輪寫入失敗
      當 到達下一輪檢查
      那麼 保留舊快照及待保存狀態並重試，不重疊啟動
rows.pending_fixture: valid old payload/index;fail new material/payload/index before publication;next polling round
rows.observable_oracle: old snapshot bytes/index remain usable;pending state retained;one retry next round with no overlap
rows.new_seams: PENDING_OWNER; no new API/port/schema/transaction approval implied

rows.pending_fixture: pause clear/merge/Undo before stable commit then complete or rollback
rows.observable_oracle: no intermediate capture;stable committed or fully rolled-back content only
rows.new_seams: PENDING_OWNER; no new API/port/schema/transaction approval implied

ac11_verbatim: AC11：虛擬時鐘60秒檢查、無變更零新快照；寫入中再編輯下一輪仍保存；索引前中斷保留舊快照；多session不覆寫。
x07_verbatim: 計時邊界59/60/61秒、慢寫跨多輪不重疊、素材中斷、索引中斷、權限與替代位置、正式保存失敗不吞dirty、session關閉時背景回報不得寫錯新文件。
